collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A fisher realizes the part they love most is mending nets in the shade, and a friend notices: admit it, or shrug.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: When (subject) was young, (subject.he/she) wanted to be the best fisher on the island. (subject.He/she) is a good fisher, not the best. Lately (subject.he/she) has noticed that what (subject.he/she) loves most is the afternoons mending nets in the shade, talking to whoever's there, while everyone else is out on the water. (friend) catches (subject.him/her) volunteering to mend nets again.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "I think I like the nets better than the fish," says (subject), a little surprised to hear (subject.him/her)self say it. (friend) laughs. "Everybody knows that. You've mended every net in the village twice." (subject) feels oddly relieved. (subject.He/she) hadn't realized it was a change until (subject.he/she) said it.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: "Someone has to do it," says (subject). (friend) raises an eyebrow but lets it go. (subject) spends the afternoon mending nets, happy as anything. (subject.He/she) still thinks of (subject.him/her)self as a fisher. (subject.He/she) may be wrong about that. It doesn't seem to matter very much.
